title: The weirdest bathroom ever
content: Last night, I was walking through a mall world. I stopped at some sort of convenience store inside. It had a couple small areas connected to it. One with a big TV with some armchairs and rugs. There was a family all cozied up in it. Next to it a cozy gaming area meant for one person. I walked past all that and found a small arcade. First, I thought it was going to be the entrance to the huge crowded playground/cafeteria area I've been in before. But I found that small arcade. There were a couple people there And then I went into the bathroom... It was covered in astroturf. There was an animatronic of a troll like Christina Aguilera. Not a full sized one. It was mounted to the wall above the door. And soo she was there singing away while people were in there. No stalls. And... just buckets. For people to go in... I wish we could screen-record our dreams and upload them lol. That bathroom was so strange
